claim: Netflix posted a 16% year-over-year decline in revenue during the fiscal second quarter of 2025.
summary: Netflix's fiscal Q2 2025 (April-June 2025) revenue grew about 16% year-over-year to ~$11.08B, not declined. The reported results were an approximately 16% increase year-over-year, the opposite direction from the claimed 16% decline.

sub_claims.text: Netflix revenue declined year-over-year in the fiscal second quarter of 2025
sub_claims.stated_text: Netflix posted a 16% year-over-year decline in revenue during the fiscal second quarter of 2025
sub_claims.note: Netflix Q2 2025 revenue was up ~15.9-16% YoY (to about $11.08B), an increase, not a decline

sub_claims.text: The year-over-year revenue change in fiscal Q2 2025 was a decline of 16%
sub_claims.note: Actual YoY change was approximately +16% growth, same magnitude but opposite sign; -16% decline did not occur
